hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | xargs -I{} sh -c 'grep -qE "ext-care-provider|ext-care-unit|ext-source-system|fail-open" "{}" 2>/dev/null && printf "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PostToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"VARNING: Inaktuella mönster hittades i {}. Kontrollera: (1) ext-care-provider/ext-care-unit/ext-source-system ska INTE användas – sourceSystem hör till meta.source, careProvider/careUnit hör till Provenance.agent. (2) fail-open ska vara fail-closed. (3) Provenance-roller: custodian=careProviderHSAId (juridiskt ansvarig), author=careUnitHSAId (informationsägare).\"}}}" || true' 2>/dev/null || true
